title: test(dogfood): pin five records-forms checklist items at the REST door (slice 2)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8EZuqRp2sWT5mEbwB3fUdmh)_

Refs #26573 (items `action-param-widgets`, `cascading-multilevel-and-clear`, `cascading-options`, `conditional-rules-header`, `field-history-tracking`; slice 2)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：records-forms 区按卡片顺序的下 5 个清单项，新增 5 个 dogfood 测试文件，在原样启动的 showcase 上经 REST 门断言它们的 api 条款，并把 5 项的 `automated.ref` 指向新钉测（revision 各加 1，history 引本卡）。
- 为什么改：18.2.0 Tier 1 扫描把这些 api 条款判为 PARTIAL（没有 oracle 层的钉测）；钉在 HTTP 层后每次发版可直接复跑。
- 风险与回滚：只加测试和清单文字，不动产品代码、不加 CI 车道；新文件落在 dogfood 现有的 isolated 项目里。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`cascade-server-boundary.dogfood.test.ts`（两个 KNOWN GAP 按现状钉住：服务端哪天开始拦截就会变红，按条目自己的话应另开卡，而不是算通过）；`field-history-tracking-activity.dogfood.test.ts`（未追踪字段的实测摘要是 #25787 通用框架，会写出字段标签 Website 但不写值）。
- 两分钟验证：先建依赖闭包，再 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/action-param-gallery-dispatch.dogfood.test.ts test/cascade-server-boundary.dogfood.test.ts test/cascade-role-gated-option.dogfood.test.ts test/invoice-conditional-rules-server.dogfood.test.ts test/field-history-tracking-activity.dogfood.test.ts`，预期 5 个文件 14 个用例全绿；`node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` 预期 OK。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Five new dogfood files, each booting the showcase as shipped through `@objectstack/verify` and driving its REST doors:

| Item (rev → new) | Clauses now pinned over REST | Pin |
|---|---|---|
| `action-param-widgets` (4 → 5) | acceptance[2], negative[1], acceptance[3] server half | `action-param-gallery-dispatch.dogfood.test.ts`: the gallery action's body has no side effect and echoes `received`, so every refusal asserts the echo is absent (the body never ran); a bag missing only `p_text` is its own case |
| `cascading-multilevel-and-clear` (8 → 9) | acceptance[2], [4], [5], negative[2] (plus negative[0]–[1] as the control) | `cascade-server-boundary.dogfood.test.ts`: the two recorded gaps pinned as they stand today |
| `cascading-options` (6 → 7) | acceptance[2] persistence and server halves, acceptance[4], negative[1] | `cascade-role-gated-option.dogfood.test.ts`: a member graded `admin` (positions read back with `org_admin`) vs a plain member |
| `conditional-rules-header` (5 → 6) | acceptance[1], acceptance[2] server half, acceptance[5] API half, negative[0]–[1] | `invoice-conditional-rules-server.dogfood.test.ts`: requiredWhen refusal and readonlyWhen strip on seeded `INV-1003` |
| `field-history-tracking` (7 → 8) | acceptance[0], [1], [3], negative[0], [2] | `field-history-tracking-activity.dogfood.test.ts`: the sys_activity summary rows and `GET /auth/me/permissions` |

Each item's `automated.ref` keeps the pins it already named and adds the new one with what it scores. One history row per item, citing #26573. No clause text, fixture, step or `knownGaps` line was edited (the claim's file surface).

**Skipped, by the slice-2 order:**

- `record-discussion-mentions`: waits on #26625 (the walled two-organization recipe).
- `adhoc-filter-sort-builder`: next in card order, but every clause is a network/dom oracle; it needs Playwright, and the ruling adds no lane.
- Browser legs inside the five items, left unpinned: `action-param-widgets` acceptance[0], [1], acceptance[3] dialog half, negative[0]; `cascading-multilevel-and-clear` acceptance[0], [3]; `cascading-options` acceptance[0], [3] and acceptance[2]'s "sees" half; `conditional-rules-header` acceptance[0], [2] client lock, [3], [4], negative[2]; `field-history-tracking` acceptance[2], negative[1]. `cascading-*` acceptance[1] stays on the objectui live spec and `field-history-tracking` acceptance[4] on its unit pin.

## Why

The 18.2.0 release-candidate Tier 1 run scored these api clauses PARTIAL: no pin asserted them at the oracle's layer, so each sweep drove them by hand. The triage ruling allows ~5-item slices and no new CI lane; the new files fall under the dogfood package's existing `isolated` vitest project and run where the dogfood legs run today.

## Tests

Measured answers the pins now hold (all first read live, then pinned exactly):

- gallery dispatch: the conformant bag → `200` with the body's `received` echo; out-of-set `p_priority` + undeclared `bogus` → `400` naming both, no echo; only `p_text` missing → `400` naming `p_text`, no echo.
- cascade: create `{cn, zj}` then PATCH `{country:'us'}` → `200`, re-read holds `province: 'zj'`; the same pair in the payload → `400` `province` / `invalid_option`. Invoice on Contoso with an existing Northwind contact → `201`, stored as sent; a fabricated contact → `400` `contact` / `reference_not_found`, nothing stored.
- role gate: the graded member's `tier: 'restricted'` → `201`, re-reads; the plain member's → `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` `tier` / `invalid_option`, nothing stored; `tier: 'standard'` → `201`.
- invoice: `status: 'sent'` without `issued_on` → `400` with exactly `[issued_on, required]`, nothing stored; draft and dated-sent → `201`. PATCH `tax_rate: 99` on paid `INV-1003` → `200`, re-read unchanged; the same PATCH on a draft persists.
- history: PATCH industry retail → finance lands `summary: 'Industry: Retail → Finance'` (message key `fieldChanges`); a website-only PATCH lands `Updated Account (Success Overlay) "<name>": Website` (key `activityUpdatedFields`, no arrow, neither URL). `/auth/me/permissions` → `objects.showcase_account.apiOperations` contains `history`; `showcase_task`'s contains `get`, not `history`.

<details><summary>Runs</summary>

- Dependency closure on `8b276385` (the restarted branch): `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/dogfood^...' --concurrency=2` under `os-verify-lock.sh`, held 8m34s.
- First run of the five files: `Tests 11 passed | 3 failed (14)`, all three in the history file: `Object 'sys_activity' not found` (the showcase boot composes no audit plugin) and `apiOperations` read from the wrong key. Fixed by adding `AuditPlugin` and reading `objects.<name>.apiOperations`; the untracked-edit case was then re-pinned to the measured #25787 generic frame.
- Commit head: the five files → `Test Files 5 passed (5)`, `Tests 14 passed (14)`; `pnpm typecheck` in `packages/qa/dogfood` (`tsc --noEmit`) → exit 0.
- Final head `efe6101e` (after merging `origin/main` `c8583f80`, which brought #26797 and #26796: dogfood tests, the access-security area file and create-objectstack, none in this diff's pins' closure): the five files → `Test Files 5 passed (5)`, `Tests 14 passed (14)`, then the dogfood typecheck, one locked command, VERDICT command-exit 0.

</details>

No ablation was run: this diff adds tests and changes no behaviour they pin. Each refusal assertion has a same-door admitted control beside it, so none passes on a door that refuses everything.

## Acceptance notes

- `field-history-tracking`: the showcase boot composes no audit plugin, so this file adds `AuditPlugin` the way `objectstack serve` composes it (as `activity-withheld-update.dogfood.test.ts` does). acceptance[1] says "no field-diff summary naming website"; the measured row is the #25787 generic frame, which names the changed field's label and never its values, so the pin asserts no old → new for website. The clause text was not reworded (outside the claim's surface).
- `cascading-multilevel-and-clear` acceptance[2] and [4] are KNOWN GAP clauses: the pins assert today's 200/201, so new server enforcement turns them red, which by the item's own text is new enforcement to file, not a pass.
- `cascading-options` acceptance[2]: the seeded admin is `org_owner`, which does not imply `org_admin`, so the admin persona is a signed-up member whose `sys_member` row is graded `admin`, read back from the resolved positions before any write.

## Verification

- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` → exit 0, `OK — 16 areas, 329 items (324 active, 1 planned)`, on the commit head and again on the final head.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` → 55 commands on the tree of this PR's commit `38c2de88` (run before a message-only reword), each run and reconciled with `--ran`: `55 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 55 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`, all exit 0.
- CI families are read from this PR's check-runs, not re-run locally. `Dogfood Regression Gate` does not run on pull_request, so the local runs above are this PR's evidence for the new pins.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (CI-owned run)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset — nothing publishes here (`@objectstack/dogfood` is private; `docs/qa/**` ships in no package), so `skip-changeset`; both declaration lines are filled in above.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the maintainer brief above is Chinese by the repo's communication rule).
